question:
Governments are trying to make rules for businesses simpler and easier to understand.

This approach is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Streamlining regulations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Streamlining regulations** refers to the process of simplifying, clarifying, and making business rules and regulations easier to understand and implement for organizations.
 
• Governments adopt this approach to reduce unnecessary bureaucratic hurdles and make compliance easier for businesses, promoting growth and efficiency.
 
• This method includes eliminating outdated or redundant regulations, thereby creating a more conducive environment for businesses to operate.
 
• By streamlining regulations, governments aim to encourage entrepreneurship and foreign investments by minimizing delays caused by complex legal and administrative procedures.
